purpose: Select one finite Campaign052 historical-only mechanism without reading its factor values, comparison values, daily prices, or forward returns.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures the stability of the issuer's reporting process across four consecutive fiscal quarters. Existing disclosure factors measure only the latest announcement's age or latest report delay, not variation across a fixed multi-report history.
These are the terminal quarterly_announcement_freshness_60s and quarterly_announcement_timeliness_days mechanisms.
A location statistic would mainly restate timeliness and introduce a post-selection choice among equivalent centers; Campaign052 freezes dispersion only.
Calendar intervals between announcements are mechanically seasonal around annual and first-quarter reporting. The selected mechanism compares each announcement with its own fiscal period end instead.
Four consecutive fiscal quarters are fixed once to cover one reporting cycle; no lookback search is allowed.
Population standard deviation is the sole dispersion estimator; alternate robust, scaled, range, or trend summaries would create an estimator search.
ROE, profit, growth, price, activity, fitted weights, filters, regimes, terminal factor values, and models are outside Campaign052.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_announcement_delay_consistency_4q
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Stable reporting delays across a complete four-quarter cycle indicate a repeatable disclosure process and lower near-term information-timing uncertainty, potentially leaving a more resilient close-known state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: For the latest four distinct effective reports whose report dates are four consecutive calendar quarter ends, let d_j be the nonnegative integer calendar days from report_date_j to announcement_date_j. Let sigma be the population standard deviation of the four d_j values. Return 1/(1+sigma).
selected_candidate.report_period_rule: the selected report dates must be distinct exact calendar quarter ends and consecutive in Q-DEC fiscal-quarter order
selected_candidate.delay_definition: integer calendar days announcement_date minus report_date
selected_candidate.delay_rule: each delay must be finite and nonnegative
selected_candidate.availability_rule: a report is usable only on accepted stock-days strictly after its announcement date
selected_candidate.dispersion_estimator: equal-weight population standard deviation over exactly four delays
selected_candidate.normalization: one divided by one plus population standard deviation

decision.next_action: perform a separate pre-value mechanism-overlap audit and freeze the exact 75-comparison no-return protocol before factor values
